preconditions.description: The number of pairs n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of colors k must be between 2 and 200,000.

postconditions.description: If no suitable color choosing exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by n lines of color pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(b) <= k and 1 <= int(g) <= k for b, g in pairs)
postconditions.description: All costume colors must be integers between 1 and k.

postconditions.expression: all(b != g for b, g in pairs)
postconditions.description: No pair can have the same color for both the man and the woman.

postconditions.expression: all(b != b_next and g != g_next for (b, g), (b_next, g_next) in zip(pairs, pairs[1:]))
postconditions.description: Consecutive pairs must have different colors for both the man and the woman.
